{{Quote|I'm a slicer, friend. We specialize in doing the wrong thing.|Cale Herron to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FCH" />}}
'''Cale Herron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You don't know the half of it. This isn't the only biologist that has met with an unfortunate end. I just read some HoloNet news about a few high profile scientists that have turned up 'missing'.|Cale Herron|<ref name="SWG:FCH" />}}
Cale Herron was a slicer who resided in [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]], on the desert planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:FCH" /> He also owned an [[Cale's Lok Outpost|outpost]] on the remote planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:TP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Plan|Tatooine}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Cale Herron was contacted by a long time associate, the biologist [[Derg Prantis]] from [[Mos Eisley Biolab]]. Prantis had obtained a sample of the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist and performed his own research on the virus in order to create a super soldier drug. However, Prantis was betrayed by his lab assistant, [[Bera Jeza]], who contacted the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to sell him the drug. Derg Prantis requested some assistance to evacuate a [[Secret Laboratory|secret laboratory]] on Lok, near Cale Herron's outpost, and destroy evidence.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> Herron later started investigating the disappearance of several high profile scientists all around the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:FCH" />

[[File:CaleHerronLokOutpost-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cale Herron, inside his [[Cale's Lok Outpost|Lok Outpost]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Derg Prantis was finally [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], as well as his assistant, Bera Jeza, on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:BJE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bera Jeza's Employer|Tatooine}}</ref> Because of the ties between Jeza and Jabba the Hutt, his [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the crime.<ref name="SWG:GC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Gather Clues|Tatooine}}</ref> Cale Herron was then contacted by the spacer who had found on Prantis's corpse a [[Datacard/Legends|data disk]] with the scientist's last words and instructions to contact Herron. The spacer encountered the slicer in Mos Taike and both agreed with working together to find the assassin.<ref name="SWG:FCH" />

However, Bib Fortuna urged the spacer to solve the case. Herron therefore suggested the spacer to blame [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], Jabba's rival on Tatooine. The spacer visited Lady Valarian at the [[Lucky Despot]], in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and accused the criminal of the murder. Indeed, Lady Valarian was not eager to be held responsible for a murder she did not order. Valarian then ordered the assassin [[Titus Sypknee]] to get rid of the spacer but he was soon killed by the spacer.<ref name="SWG:TV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Valarians?|Tatooine}}</ref> The spacer eventually forced Lady Valarian to pay reparations to Jabba the Hutt.<ref name="SWG:JC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba Communication|Tatooine}}</ref>

[[File:SecretLaboratory3.jpg|200px|thumb|A mysterious datapad next to the body of a dead Twi'lek.]]
Cale Herron and the spacer later traveled to the slicer's outpost on Lok in order to continue their investigation.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> Herron tasked the spacer to investigate Derg Prantis' secret laboratory on Lok. The spacer discovered that the lab was brutally attacked and the entire staff was assassinated. The spacer ended up finding a mysterious [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] next to the body of a [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]].<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Clues|Lok}}</ref> In the meantime, Cale sliced the [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] around Lok and intercepted a large amount of communication traffic from the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The spacer therefore traveled to the origin of the transmission on Dathomir. The spacer found that the area was [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|quarantined]] by [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military forces]]. Nevertheless, the spacer managed to discussed with three scared people, [[Illrian Nhagy]], [[Tk-216]], [[Tyla Gallamby]], from whom the spacer discovered that an accident happened at a secret [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]], resulting in an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak of the Blackwing virus]]. After the discovery of this frightening situation, Cale Herron eventually contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to notify what was happening on Dathomir.<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref> The spacer was then recruited to work in the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cale Herron appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FCH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Cale Herron was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This NPC was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:FCH" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
